b.s: Depicting the fragmentation of the Moon and survival of humanity aboard the Cloud Ark in Neal Stephenson’s Seveneves, alongside the mysterious extraterrestrial monuments on Iapetus and Beta Hydri in Jack McDevitt’s The Engines of God.
